links.outcome: Agreement of standalone LLM recommendations with consultant-led MDT reference standard
links.effect: Overall agreement 93.2% Gemini (κ=0.87), 92.9% Claude, 91.8% ChatGPT, 88.8% DeepSeek; confirmed safety events 2.6-6.0% of evaluations.
links.quote: Overall agreement was highest for Gemini (93.2%; κ = 0.87), followed by Claude (92.9%; κ = 0.86), ChatGPT (91.8%; κ = 0.84), and DeepSeek (88.8%; κ = 0.79).

unlisted_practices: Using inter-model consensus across multiple LLMs as a signal of recommendation reliability

screen.reason: Prospective longitudinal observational study comparing frontier LLM outputs against consultant-led MDT reference standards in perioperative care using identical locked prompts, evaluating accuracy and safety events without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
